'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****[[Portugal]] reports its first cases of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]] in 13 people associated with [[Belenenses SAD]] football club. [https://apnews.com/f18ea81f76da6dd22d455234d9605f53 (AP)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****[[Spain]] reports its first case of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in a person who travelled from [[South Africa]]. [https://english.elpais.com/society/2021-11-29/first-case-of-omicron-variant-detected-in-spain-in-traveler-from-south-africa.html (''El Pais'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sweden]]
****[[Sweden]] reports its first case of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in a person who travelled from [[South Africa]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-variant-sweden-idUSL1N2SK1LW (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]]
****Miss Universe France 2021, [[Clémence Botino]], a contestant at the [[Miss Universe]] contest in [[Eilat]], [[Israel]], tests positive for [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.lindependant.fr/amp/2021/11/29/concours-miss-univers-miss-france-2020-testee-positive-au-covid-des-son-arrivee-en-israel-9959151.php (''L'Independant'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in the Philippines]]
****The [[Philippines]] launches a campaign to vaccinate 9 million people in three days in order to achieve 70% vaccination target and to prevent the spread of the Omicron variant. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/covid-19-philippines-launches-campaign-to-vaccinate-9-million-people-in-three-days (''The Straits Times'')]
**[[International aid related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Angola]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Kenya]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Barbados]]
****[[Argentina]] donates 780,000 doses of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine]] to [[Angola]], [[Kenya]] and [[Barbados]], which have all detected cases of the [[Omicron variant]]. [https://lmdiario.com.ar/contenido/318910/argentina-dono-780-mil-vacunas-a-paises-que-detectaron-la-variante-omicron (LMDiario)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
****[[Michigan]] reports 4,181 hospitalizations from [[COVID-19]], a new single-day record. [https://www.detroitnews.com/story/news/local/michigan/2021/11/29/michigan-hits-new-record-adult-covid-19-hospitalizations-80-beds-full/8786165002/ (''The Detroit News'')]
**[[History of COVID-19 vaccine development]]
***[[BioNTech]] says that it is developing a [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] to combat the Omicron variant. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/stocks/biontech-starts-work-omicron-specific-vaccine-2021-11-29/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Foreign relations of Turkey]]
**[[President of Turkey|Turkish President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] reveals his intentions to rebuild his country's ties with [[Egypt–Turkey relations|Egypt]] and [[Israel–Turkey relations|Israel]]. [https://www.trtworld.com/turkey/erdogan-turkey-seeks-to-improve-ties-with-egypt-israel-52128 (TRT World)]
* [[Holy See–Russia relations]]
**Cardinal [[Miguel Ángel Ayuso Guixot]], the president of the [[Pontifical Council for Interreligious Dialogue]] began a six-day journey to Russia on November 23. Guixot met with Orthodox, Muslim, civil leaders. The parties discussed religious liberty and other human rights of minorities. [https://www.catholicculture.org/news/headlines/index.cfm?storyid=53044 (Catholic World News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Honduran general election]]
**While votes are still being counted, both [[Xiomara Castro]] and [[Nasry Asfura]] declare that their respective tickets have won the presidential election. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/11/29/opposition-ruling-party-claim-poll-win-after-massive-turnout (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Magdalena Andersson]] is re-elected as [[Prime Minister of Sweden]] by the [[Riksdag]] after she resigned last week. [https://www.euronews.com/2021/11/29/magdalena-andersson-set-to-be-chosen-as-sweden-s-first-female-pm-again (Euronews)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Jack Dorsey]] resigns as the [[Chief executive officer|CEO]] of [[Twitter]] and is succeeded by [[Chief technology officer]] [[Parag Agrawal]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/11/29/twitter-ceo-jack-dorsey-is-expected-to-step-down-sources-say.html (CNBC)]
*Researchers from the [[National Autonomous University of Mexico]] discover two new antibiotic molecules inside the venom of a scorpion from the ''[[Diplocentrus]]'' genus, which may hold the properties to stop several different kinds of harmful bacteria and tumour cells.
